trace_replay_grid.warning: offline replay is a mechanism analysis, not measured policy latency

primary_followup: structured_complete vs complete: strict, closure_tolerant, wrapper-balanced and last-marked endpoints
entropy_observe vs complete: exact-output-matched runtime per independent session
boundary_observe vs uniform: exact-output-matched boundary detection runtime
entropy_uniform vs boundary_observe: added entropy path at baseline stopping length
multiplicity: Follow-up endpoints are exploratory; 95% intervals are descriptive and not confirmatory. Freeze a separate adjusted primary family before any confirmatory follow-up.
limitations: No human semantic outcomes; no historical Legacy code recreation; existing cohorts already inspected. Timing pilot is separate and must not be pooled into formal timing.
